[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>. She spins and her skirt and head wrap fly out in a wide circle, the crowd cheers around her, while the camera circles slowly with her, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
